ourComparison.arm: run 44017278305 (S16), majority of four repetitions, deepseek-chat reader and judge

reading.theGapIsNotProtocol: our 30 abstention questions are 30/30, so excluding them LOWERS our score (90.80 -> 90.21) while it raises theirs (95.6 -> 95.7). The 5.4-point gap on the all-500 basis is not an artefact of where the denominator starts.
reading.theGapIsUniform: measured on the categories that map one-to-one: multi-session 91.7 against our 83.47 (-8.2), temporal-reasoning 97.7 against 93.70 (-4.0), knowledge-update 97.4 against 93.06 (-4.3), single-session 95.7-96.7 against our 91.33 (-4.4 to -5.4).
reading.whatThatImplies: a deficit that is present on every capability and largest on the one with the longest contexts is what a weaker reader predicts, not what a missing per-capability mechanism predicts. Our reader is deepseek-chat; theirs is gemini-3.8-flash with a gpt-4o judge. Mastra's own paired ablation prices the reader at +10.64 points, which is larger than the whole gap.
reading.categoryCountsDiffer: their multi-session is 133 and ours is 121 because LongMemEval's abstention questions carry the type of the question they were derived from; ours are collected into a separate ABS capability. The comparison above is therefore between 121 non-abstention multi-session questions and 133 that mix in 12 abstention ones, which if anything flatters them.
reading.notMeasuredHere: their run and ours do not share an answer model or a judge, so no column of this table is a mechanism comparison. That requires running their harness with our models, which is the next dispatch's purpose.
